desc: A hawk spirit: deep violet feathers, crimson crystal wing tips, small curved gold beak, proud confident pose. Cute but cool game pet creature, chibi 2-head-tall, right-facing 3/4 view, full body. True 16-bit pixel art, uniform 1px dark navy outline, 2-3 flat shade colors, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, no noise. Small crisp dark eyes with 1px white highlight, friendly not scary. Lavender, pale white, deep violet and warm gold palette. No halo, no sparkles, no shadow.
